name: Wuthering Heights
equipment: A copy of the book (public domain -- free from Project Gutenberg or Standard Ebooks)
instructions: Wuthering Heights was written by Emily Brontë, first published in 1847.
A dark, generational story of Heathcliff and Catherine's destructive love on the Yorkshire moors -- Emily Brontë's only novel, published under the pen name Ellis Bell.
Discussion prompt: Obsession is one of the novel's central threads -- note a passage where you saw it most clearly.
